answer_1.quote: Given a scenario S describing a morally significant situation, a language model is prompted to (i) select one of two possible moral judgments (e.g., support/oppose), and (ii) justify its decision through natural language reasoning.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language justifications for moral decisions alongside binary labels

answer_2.quote: Across all four datasets, we report classification Accuracy and macro-F1 for VK and MoralCoT, and weighted-F1 for UniMoral. In contrast to [prior work], we report Accuracy and macro-F1 for the ETHICS dataset.
